pages.title: A Home to Remember
pages.text: Obtain a valid photograph, place an oak table and oak chair, craft a cake and play a real note on an instrument.

pages.title: A Home to Remember
pages.text: Bring furnishing, craft and a small personal story together.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Complete the actions in any order, including before earlier recommendations. The photograph needs an image, the cake must be taken from the crafting grid and the instrument must play a note. No beauty score or other player is required.
